inclusion_rule.epoch_frontier_model: Credited on at least one model flagged 'Frontier model' in the Epoch AI notable-models database with a publication date in 2000 or later. Mechanical: it is a query, not a judgement.
inclusion_rule.editorial: Included despite the mechanical rule not selecting it. Requires inclusion_reason naming what the rule missed. Necessary because Epoch's flag is sparse -- 123 of 1,034 rows in the dump carry it -- so its absence is not evidence an organisation is not frontier.
inclusion_rule.lab_kind: Provided so a consumer counting 'how many frontier labs exist' picks its own filter rather than inheriting ours. Counting dedicated_ai_lab gives a very different number from counting every row.
